description: This Java source file defines the configuration for the Loan Chain of Business (COB) process in the Fineract project, including batch job setup, steps, and listeners.

classes.name: LoanCOBManagerConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up the Loan COB batch job, including steps, partitioner, and listeners.

methods.name: partitioner
methods.description: Creates a LoanCOBPartitioner bean for partitioning the loan COB process.

methods.name: loanCOBStep
methods.description: Defines the main partitioned step for processing loans in COB.

methods.name: resolveCustomJobParametersStep
methods.description: Defines a step to resolve custom job parameters.

methods.name: stayedLockedStep
methods.description: Defines a step to handle stayed locked loans.

methods.name: resolveCustomJobParametersTasklet
methods.description: Creates a tasklet for resolving custom job parameters.

methods.name: stayedLockedTasklet
methods.description: Creates a tasklet for processing stayed locked loans.

methods.name: loanCOBJob
methods.description: Defines the main job combining all steps and listeners for the Loan COB process.

methods.name: customJobParametersPromotionListener
methods.description: Creates a listener to promote specific job parameters to the execution context.
